body.query: What kind of currency did the customer paid at 16:25:00 in 2012/8/24?

raw_response.sql:
SELECT c.currency
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c
  ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
WHERE t.date = DATE '2012-08-24'
  AND t.time = TIME '16:25:00';
